# epicsagas.github.io

> Portfolio hub of epic (epicsagas) — Platform & Infra engineer building AI-native developer tooling in Rust: MCP servers, agent harnesses, research pipelines. Former commerce / regulated fintech / crypto / security engineer on AWS/GCP.

## Profile

- Focus: AI-native developer tooling — every tool ships as both a CLI and an MCP server, installable as plugins on 5+ agent hosts (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline)
- Languages: Rust, Go, TypeScript, Flutter/Dart, Svelte
- Method: single Rust binaries, SQLite + FTS5, static sites, no build step
- The full profile and contribution history live at github.com/epicsagas

## Research sites (sub-pages)

- [The Ontology Lineage](https://epicsagas.github.io/ontology-explorer/en/): 2,300 years of ontology research on one static page — lineage timeline, integrated architecture, five-stage learning route, browser for 425 papers (ko/en). LLM export: /ontology-explorer/llms-full.txt
- [The Uncanny Valley of AI Writing](https://epicsagas.github.io/uncanny-writing/): fact-checked dossier on why readers turn away from AI-generated text — 5 sources verified, 86 papers indexed, 4 open gaps (ko/en). LLM export: /uncanny-writing/llms-full.txt

## Featured projects

- [research-agent](https://github.com/epicsagas/research-agent): research memory for AI agents — arXiv/OpenAlex to SQLite, LLM gap analysis, survey reports (Rust CLI + 18-tool MCP server)
- [epic-harness](https://github.com/epicsagas/epic-harness): multi-tool AI agent harness — 22 skills, self-evolving engine, spec-to-PR pipeline
- [alcove](https://github.com/epicsagas/alcove): MCP doc server — BM25 + vector hybrid search, tree-sitter code indexing
- [Velith](https://github.com/epicsagas/Velith): AI-native publishing — 6-phase book pipeline to EPUB/PDF
- [llm-kernel](https://github.com/epicsagas/llm-kernel): Rust foundation library — provider catalog, MCP server, ONNX embeddings
- [opencodex](https://github.com/epicsagas/opencodex): universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code

## More tools

- [Episteme](https://github.com/epicsagas/Episteme) (SE knowledge graph), [claudy](https://github.com/epicsagas/claudy) (multi-provider launcher), [llm-transpile](https://github.com/epicsagas/llm-transpile) (token-budget transpiler), [obsidian-forge](https://github.com/epicsagas/obsidian-forge) (vault automation), [plugins](https://github.com/epicsagas/plugins) (Claude Code-only plugin marketplace), [homebrew-tap](https://github.com/epicsagas/homebrew-tap)
